rejected_lenses.reason: Reject as a broad verification-quality claim rather than one distinct failure lens. It bundles several unrelated boundaries and failure cases, some not established as requirements, without defining a single expected externally observable outcome.

audit_summary: Accepted four materially distinct lenses covering an ambiguous output contract, content-preservation violations, loss of settled decisions in the handoff, and regressions to existing behavior. Rejected the happy-path verification lens because it aggregates unspecified behaviors and evaluates test breadth rather than a discrete solution-neutral failure.
